seo.titulo: Content approval for agency clients | Clipfine
seo.descripcion: Your clients approve or request changes on every clip before it goes out, in writing or by voice note. No more back-and-forth over chat. Built for agencies.

bajada: What your team schedules waits for someone to approve it. Your client watches the clip, approves it with one tap or asks for changes with a voice note, and nothing goes out without their yes.

p1.p: Does my client have to learn Clipfine to approve?
p1.r: No. You invite them with the Reviewer role: they get the alert, watch the clip and tap Approve or Request changes. They can do it on the web or in the app.

p2.p: What if the client doesn't approve in time?
p2.r: Clipfine sends a heads-up 2 hours before it's due. If time runs out without approval, it doesn't go out. If the brand chose to publish anyway, it goes out and is marked Went out unreviewed.

p3.p: Can I turn it on for only some clients?
p3.r: Yes. Review is turned on per brand, from Team, and for each brand you choose who reviews.
